Author: Kotanna
Name: Job Profiles
Punchline: Switch HUD layout, mount and minion when you change job, and give controller buttons job-specific actions.
Description: For each role (or a single job), pick a HUD layout, mounts and minions. When you switch to it, however you change job, the HUD layout changes, a random minion of the job's is summoned, and Mount Roulette rides one of its mounts. Right-click a mount or minion in the game's Mount or Minion Guide to choose which roles and jobs use it. Controller buttons, button combos and keys can also do different things depending on your job and the duty you're in, or hold a key, e.g. to open a Flick Wheel wheel. /jobprofiles opens settings; /jobprofiles apply applies your current job's settings again.
